doc.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024

chapter: Studio work and playing by ear
title: The eight-page discography
summary: Rowe shows a printed discography and they joke about writing it out by hand.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: I prepared a little prop here. This is a list, a discography of Fred Wesley.
You see this? From the internet.
I’m getting tired just looking at that.
You wonder how you fit it all in.

That’s something I’ll try to scan it or maybe — you know what I’ll do? I’ll take a long bus ride and I’ll write it out by hand like you used to do. I can just see — you know I’ve done that kind of thing. I don’t know if I’ve done it on a bus but I can just picture you like writing a rhythm and you hit a bump.
Yup. Imagine me doing it with a ball point pen like Dennis Wilson did. But —
